Firefly Android Launcher is a Minecraft Java Edition launcher for Android developed by HGSpace Studio, based on PojavLauncher and Pojav Glow·Worm.
Firefly Android Launcher has optimized UI interactions and renderer selection options, and supports CurseForge and Modrinth modpack imports.
Firefly Android Launcher uses the GPLv3 open source license.
Third party components and their licenses

Boardwalk (JVM Launcher): Unknown License/Apache License 2.0 or GNU GPLv2.
 Android Support Libraries: Apache License 2.0.
 GL4ES: MIT License.
 OpenJDK: GNU GPLv2 License.
 LWJGL3: BSD-3 License.
 LWJGLX (LWJGL2 API compatibility layer for LWJGL3): unknown license.
 Mesa 3D Graphics Library: MIT License.
 pro-grade (Java sandboxing security manager): Apache License 2.0.
 bhook (Used for exit code trapping): MIT license.
 libepoxy: MIT License.
 virglrenderer: MIT License.
 terminal-view: Apache 2.0.
 terminal-emulator: Apache 2.0.
 Thanks to all who have been supporting HGSpace Studio Firefly Development Team.
Project Contributor(Irrespective of contribution rate and contribution order)

Firefly Android Launcher 是由 HGSpace Studio 開發的 Minecraft Java Edition 安卓啟動器，基於 PojavLauncher 和 Pojav Glow·Worm 開發。
Firefly Android Launcher 針對 UI 互動和渲染器選擇方案進行了優化，支援 CurseForge 和 Modrinth 整合包導入。
Firefly Android Launcher 使用 GPLv3 開源協議。

Boardwalk (JVM 啟動器)：未知許可/Apache 許可證 2.0 或 GNU GPLv2
 Android Support Libraries：Apache 許可證 2.0
 GL4ES：MIT 許可證
 OpenJDK：GNU GPLv2 許可證
 LWJGL3：BSD-3 許可證
 LWJGLX (LWJGL2 API 相容層用於 LWJGL3)：未知許可
